title: How Long Does Ground Meat Last in the Fridge?

seo.title: How Long Does Ground Meat Last in the Fridge?
seo.meta_description: Raw ground meat has a shorter refrigerated window than many whole cuts. Learn the safe range and when to cook, freeze, or discard it.
seo.search_intent: Determine how long raw ground meat can be refrigerated and when to cook it, freeze it, or throw it away.

excerpt: Raw ground meat has a short refrigerator window. Plan to cook it promptly or freeze it while it is still safely within that window.
content_html:
A common food-safety guideline for raw ground meat is 1 to 2 days in a refrigerator at 40°F (4°C) or below. If you will not cook it within that time, freeze it while it is still safely refrigerated.

Count from purchase or refrigerator thawing

If the meat thawed in the refrigerator, the short refrigerated window matters once thawed. A store date does not compensate for poor temperature control.

Store it low and contain leaks

Keep the package sealed on a plate or in a container, preferably on a lower shelf, so raw juices cannot drip onto ready-to-eat foods.

Color and smell cannot prove safety

A bad odor or slimy texture is reason to discard the meat, but normal appearance does not guarantee that harmful bacteria are absent. Never taste raw meat as a test.

Room-temperature time matters

Raw ground meat left out for more than about two hours, or less in very hot conditions, should be discarded rather than chilled again.

This guidance is for raw ground meat. Cooked ground meat has a different refrigerated storage window.

faq.question: How long can raw ground meat stay refrigerated?
faq.answer: A common guideline is 1 to 2 days at 40°F (4°C) or below.

faq.question: Should I freeze it if I will not cook it tomorrow?
faq.answer: Freezing it while still within the safe refrigerated window is a sensible option.

faq.question: Is it safe if it smells normal?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Smell cannot detect all harmful bacteria.
